hero.h1_classes: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-normal tracking-tight leading-[1.1] text-white mb-6
hero.cta_classes: px-4 py-2 text-xs text-white bg-gradient-to-b from-[#3a3a3a] to-[#1a1a1a] hover:from-[#444] hover:to-[#222] rounded-lg border border-white/[0.1] transition-colors font-light shadow-lg flex items-center gap-2

keyframes_css: @keyframes ray-sweep { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(35deg) scaleY(1); opacity: 0.4; } 50% { transform: rotate(30deg) scaleY(1.4); opacity: 0.8; } }
@keyframes ray-sweep-2 { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(25deg) translateY(0); opacity: 0.5; } 50% { transform: rotate(28deg) translateY(3vh) scale(1.1); opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes core-pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(25deg) scaleX(0.9); opacity: 0.4; } 50% { transform: rotate(25deg) scaleX(1.1); opacity: 1; } }
